messages:
Oncall Bot: Pager HIGH — multiple alerts for inference-serving-prod (3 events in 2m). Linking incident: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-874. Primary: @Jordan K. — unknown response status.
Alice R.: Saw the bot. Jordan is on PTO today (auto-reply). Need a deputy/hand-off, the 503s are customer-facing.
Samir V.: I was shadowed for EU night but currently in a sprint meeting. I can spin up a quick handoff if someone can cover the first 15m. Who's nearby?
Maria L.: I'm awake in EU, can be deputy for the next 3h. What's the immediate impact? Any degraded customers?
Alice R.: Symptoms: spikes of 503s on /v1/generate and elevated p95 and p99 latency for the dedicated pool. Canary fallback to cheaper model triggered twice. Customer reports: 2 support tickets from high-traffic accounts (IDs blurred) see link in incident.
Infra Pager: quick grep from prod logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-14T08:12:03Z inference-0 OOM killing process pid=4821 model=gpt-13b-quant
2026-03-14T08:12:04Z router fallback route=stable->small-lrl
2026-03-14T08:12:05Z kube evict node=gpu-45 taint:memory-pressure
```
Will paste full logs to the incident doc.
Samir V.: OK looks like memory pressure / model OOM. Runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/oom-fallback — key steps: scale pool, redirect a fraction of traffic to variant, and restart affected pods with quantized binary.
Maria L.: On it. First step: reduce traffic to the heavy config and enable canary 30% to small model. Can someone lgtm the routing change? Command I plan to run: `redwood route update --service inference-prod --model gpt-small --pct 30 --reason "auto-deputy-hand-off"`
Alice R.: I can approve. Also we should add a temporary capacity floor: `k8s hpa set inference-worker --min 6` — need Eng Runtime to confirm safe.
Eng Runtime Pager: Aware, prepping a scale-up on the dedicated pool. We can add 2 GPUs but it will take ~4 minutes to spin up. If you toggle canary first that will drop immediate errors.
Samir V.: Maria, when you flip the 30% canary I'll watch for error rate change. If errors drop within 2 min we keep canary and proceed to scale. If not, we'll widen fallback and open a bridge.
Maria L.: Executing now: `> redwood route update --service inference-prod --model gpt-small --pct 30`
Oncall Bot: Action logged by Maria L. — routing update submitted (change id r-2026-03-14-01).
Infra Pager: Metrics after 90s: error rate p50->p95: 503s dropped from 12% to 4%, latency p99 improved ~1.8s.
Maria L.: Good. Eng Runtime — please proceed with +2 GPU scale. Also I'll start a short bridge for any customer ops questions in #support-ops.
Eng Runtime Pager: Scaling now, pods provisioning. ETA ~3:30. I'll post when nodes are ready.
Alice R.: Noted. Maria, please take on primary for the next 3h and update the rotation calendar so Jordan's PTO doesn't auto-expire the handoff. Samir — you'll be secondary.
Samir V.: Acknowledged. I'll stay on standby for 1h then hand back if stable.
Maria L.: Primary accepted. Running quick healthcheck script and will annotate the incident doc with the steps we ran + next steps. If error rate stays <5% after scale, we'll close the bridge and keep a 1hr warm shadow. :thumbsup:
Alice R.: Thanks everyone. Post-incident follow-up: add a short blurb to the runbook about lowering default initial model mem requests for hot-shard models and consider automated pre-warming on holidays.
Oncall Bot: Incident status: mitigated -> keeping incident open in monitoring for 60m. Notifications sent to rotation leads.
